title: poor month view
body:
I tested 7 of these habit/ritual tracker apps.  this was 2nd worse and 2nd most expensive mmm....

this app was most complicated to use of all

key points
1 no ability to tap to switch from week ti calender view.  I prefer calender as gives bigger context than week.  their month is a row, plain silly to use as too tiny to tap

2 no current streak, longest streak and total in quick listing of all habits 

3 no ability to tap planned days, say 26 days in 30 -- I can do my activity on any day just need to be 26 within 30.  I like to plan these days, then tap when done

4 takes two taps rather than 1 tsp to say I'm done.  cumbersome
they have tried to make the tracker better by asking you to specify skip or not done.  way way too much maintenance.  felt like an accountant.  rather simpler, for me, to put your Programme in, then 1 tap to say done that day.

5 no ability to specify by visual que the activity you did (eg easy run, hill run, long run) (by change in colour shade for day - very light blue, light blue, mid blue

6 no nice ritual layout view (by rows) as in ritual app
